senses.zh_definition: 未核实为标准马来语词。若指《乐高大电影》中的 Kragle，则是片中胶水武器的专名；仅凭当前数据包不能确定该指称。
senses.en_definition: An unverified Malay entry; possibly the proper name Kragle for the glue weapon in The LEGO Movie.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk yang belum disahkan sebagai kata bahasa Melayu baku; mungkin merujuk kepada nama khas Kragle bagi senjata berupa gam dalam filem The LEGO Movie.
senses.nuances: noun 仅对应可能的专名用法，并非 DBP 已确认的词类。Epic 官方文档确认 Kragle 与影片胶水意象有关，但不能证明输入项是标准马来语词；以下搭配和例句均为讨论该字符串的教学示例，不声称是高频搭配或官方释义。[Epic 官方文档](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/fortnite/working-with-the-lego-brick-editor-in-fortnite?lang=en-US)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied packet provides no definition, pronunciation or Jawi spelling for kragle, so its Malay history cannot be reconstructed responsibly. A possible connection is the proper name Kragle in The LEGO Movie. Epic’s official documentation explicitly invokes that film’s glue imagery when naming a tool for joining LEGO bricks digitally. This supports the association, not a confirmed Malay etymology. [Epic documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/fortnite/working-with-the-lego-brick-editor-in-fortnite?lang=en-US)
